lanes.shopping: Pre-sale Shopping Assistant: product discovery, recommendations, comparisons and the path to cart.
lanes.support: Post-sale Support Agent: order tracking, returns, shipping, damaged items, changes and cancellations.

method.composite: weights.automation × automation % + weights.quality × quality + weights.speed × speed score, rounded
method.speed_score: (22 − mean latency in seconds) / 19 × 100, clamped to 0–100: 100 at 3 s or faster, 0 at 22 s or slower
method.overall: Mean of the shopping and support composites, for vendors ranked in both lanes
method.automation: Share of engaged conversations the AI resolved without handing over to a human or deflecting to another channel
method.quality: Blind LLM-judge score out of 100 against a fixed rubric, averaged over judged conversations
method.latency: Seconds from the shopper's message to the AI's complete final reply (a 'let me check' stall is not an answer)
method.rankable: At least 15 conversations in the lane within the ranking window, with judged quality
method.confidence_interval: composite_ci95 is a 95% interval with the storefront as the unit of replication
